parts.tooltip: fmap :: (a ⟶ M b) ⟶ M a ⟶ M (M b) — from Functor. Applies f under the outer context without removing it: Maybe 0 or 1 times, List once per element, Reader/State once the environment/state is supplied.
join :: M (M b) ⟶ M b — the monad-specific part. Merges outer and inner context: Maybe drops Nothing, List concatenates, Writer appends logs, State runs the outer then the inner computation.
